48.original: I say, are you not from Eorzea? And by the looks of it, an adventurer besides?

49.original: Marvelous! You see, I have been dispatched here by the Adventurers' Guild to spread recognition of our establishment while helping us gain a foothold here in the Far East.

50.original: And what better way to the locals' hearts than by offering them our aid─through guildleves, of course. We already have plenty of work for those with the skills, and I hope we can depend upon yours as well.

51.original: You now have access to guildleves in Kugane. Speak with Keltraeng to undertake tasks for Disciples of the Hand and Disciples of the Land.

52.original: I hope I can find skilled adventurers here, and enough of them to meet demand...

53.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must be a Disciple of the Hand or the Land of level 60 or above.
